name: WF-419 — Assignment Contract Generation & Signature Routing Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const buyerId=String(b.buyerId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,buyerId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Assignment Contract Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const buyer=ctx.buyer??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const purchasePrice=num(d.purchasePrice??d.contractPrice); const assignmentFee=num(d.assignmentFee); const buyerOffer=num(d.buyerOffer??d.offerAmount); const protectedMAO=num(d.protectedMAO??d.protectedMao); const flags=[]; if(['closed','cancelled','disputed'].includes(String(ctx.dealStatus??d.status??'').toLowerCase()))flags.push('deal_protected_state'); if(buyer.active===false)flags.push('buyer_inactive'); if(buyer.suppressed===true)flags.push('buyer_suppressed'); if(buyer.dnc===true)flags.push('buyer_dnc'); if(buyer.assignmentEligible!==true)flags.push('buyer_assignment_ineligible'); if(buyer.proofOfFundsVerified!==true)flags.push('proof_of_funds_not_verified'); if(seller.identityVerified!==true)flags.push('seller_identity_not_verified'); if(p.identityVerified!==true)flags.push('property_identity_not_verified'); if(d.contractReady!==true)flags.push('contract_not_ready'); if(d.sellerSigned!==true)flags.push('seller_signature_missing'); if(purchasePrice===null)flags.push('purchase_price_missing'); if(buyerOffer===null)flags.push('buyer_offer_missing'); if(protectedMAO!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&purchasePrice>protectedMAO)flags.push('purchase_price_above_protected_mao'); if(buyerOffer!==null&&purchasePrice!==null&&buyerOffer<purchasePrice)flags.push('buyer_offer_below_purchase_price'); const hardBlock=['deal_protected_state','buyer_inactive','buyer_suppressed','buyer_dnc','buyer_assignment_ineligible','proof_of_funds_not_verified','seller_identity_not_verified','property_identity_not_verified','contract_not_ready','seller_signature_missing','purchase_price_missing','buyer_offer_missing','purchase_price_above_protected_mao','buyer_offer_below_purchase_price']; const blocked=flags.some(x=>hardBlock.includes(x)); const documentPayload={documentType:'assignment_agreement',status:blocked?'not_ready':'ready_for_generation',dealId:input.dealId,propertyId:input.propertyId,leadId:input.leadId,sellerId:seller.id??seller.sellerId??null,buyerId:input.buyerId,purchasePrice,assignmentFee,buyerOffer,requiredSigners:[{role:'seller',id:seller.id??seller.sellerId??null},{role:'buyer',id:buyer.id??buyer.buyerId??input.buyerId}],requiredFields:['property_identity','seller_identity','buyer_identity','purchase_price','assignment_fee','effective_date','signatures'],generationControls:{doNotTreatAsExecuted:true,requiresFinalReview:true}}; const signatureRouting=blocked?{status:'blocked',routes:[],nextAction:'resolve_contract_blockers'}:{status:'ready',routes:[{role:'seller',channel:'esign',required:true},{role:'buyer',channel:'esign',required:true}],nextAction:'generate_assignment_document_and_route_for_signatures'}; const idempotencyKey='wf419:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.buyerId; return [{json:{...input,assignmentContract:{status:blocked?'blocked':'ready_for_generation',documentPayload,signatureRouting,flags,confidenceScore:blocked?Math.max(0,55-flags.length*5):Math.max(75,100-flags.length*3)},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, propertyId, dealId and buyerId are required'} }}

meta.notes: Assignment contract generation and signature routing is workflow scaffolding. It does not create a legally binding executed contract. Production use requires verified InsulaCRM contract/document schema, approved legal templates, e-signature provider, title/closing requirements, and production API contracts.
